# Airola

> Airbnb and short-let turnover cleaning in East London, with photo proof sent to your WhatsApp after every clean.

## Services

- Standard Turnover from £45 (1-bed), +£20 per extra bedroom
- Guest-Ready Plus from £79 (1-bed): adds linen change, dishwashing and pre-check-in double inspection
- Add-ons: essentials restocking £10, linen change from £15 per bed, dishwashing £10, fridge and microwave £10
- Book every turnover and save £10 per clean (£35 and £69 for a 1-bed)

## Area

Stratford, Royal Wharf, Canary Wharf, Canning Town, Hackney Wick, Bow, Mile End, Leyton

## Guarantee

First-Clean Guarantee: if the first clean is not guest-ready we re-clean the affected areas free.
